## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_VIX_TREND_OOS_CONFIRMED candidate aims to capture the edge in the SPY market by identifying trendline breaks with a VIX escalation filter. The hypothesis is that this setup can provide a positive edge in the market, especially during periods of high volatility.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves identifying trendline breaks in the SPY market and filtering them based on VIX escalation. The trendline break is detected using a combination of technical indicators, including the 5-minute chart and the VIX index. The VIX escalation filter is used to confirm the trendline break and ensure that the trade is taken in the direction of the trend.
